title: Why is my postpaid bill higher than my plan rental this month?
content:
Question: Why is my postpaid bill higher than my plan rental this month?

Answer: Charges above your base rental typically come from one or more of: pro-rated charges for a mid-cycle plan change, roaming usage, premium/IVR services, GST, or usage beyond your plan's fair-usage allowance. A full itemised breakdown is available under Billing > View Bill Details in the app.

Topic: Billing & Invoices
